---
name: edit-in-lightcraft
description: "Batch-develop camera raw photos with exposure, color and lens adjustments. Use when LightCraft is requested or the project already uses it."
applications:
  - id: lightcraft
    role: primary
---

Pinned release: [v0.5.0](https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/releases/tag/v0.5.0).
The standalone CLI installs on demand under `$VOYAGER_HOME/tools/lightcraft/0.5.0`.
macOS: `lightcraft-cli-0.5.0-macos-universal.zip`, extracted with `ditto -x -k`;
binary: `lightcraft-cli-0.5.0-macos-universal/lightcraft-cli`.
Windows: `lightcraft-0.5.0-windows-<arch>-portable.zip` (`lightcraft-cli.exe`).
Linux: `lightcraft-0.5.0-linux-<arch>.tar.gz` (`bin/lightcraft-cli`).
Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`; macOS additionally supports
`codesign --verify --strict <binary>` and `spctl --assess --type install -vv <binary>`.
The commands below use `lightcraft-cli`.

`commands --json` discovers IDs and parameter schemas;
`controls --json` lists develop sliders and ranges.
`render IN -o OUT --set light.exposure=0.5` develops one file.
`run --import DIR develop.set control=light.exposure value=0.5 app.export path=OUT`
imports and runs commands; `--library DIR` persists edits.
`mcp --library DIR [FILES/FOLDERS]` serves headless stdio MCP;
`--compact` exposes helpers instead of every command.

macOS verification developed a synthetic DNG with exposure adjustment,
exported PNG and listed MCP tools. Upstream is alpha: camera calibration
is incomplete; compressed Olympus and unsupported CR3 variants may use
embedded JPEG previews. Subject/sky masks use classical heuristics.
